title: Finite evaluation of the universal scalar cochain counit
statement: Fix a prime l, finite extensions E,L of Q_l, an embedding iota:E to L and any scheme W. Let A be coefficient-extension system data [stage3-pur-extension-reduction-data]. There are natural ordinary isomorphisms rho_n from system scalar extension followed by L-evaluation to E-evaluation followed by finite scalar extension. They respect the actual ordinary scalar adjunction units (the predicate IsCoefficientScalarEvaluationUnit). For every cochain complex C of E-coefficient systems, evaluating the system cochain counit and then rho_n equals A.evaluation n followed by the finite derived extension of the exact-evaluation localization factor and the finite scalar cochain counit. This assertion is independent of completed-coefficient reduction, an ordinary association and a direct quotient model.

source.place: sites-modules.tex, lemma-adjoint-pullback-pushforward-modules (03D7); sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-derived-base-change (06YY) and lemma-adjoint (07A6); step 2 of stage3-pur-extension-strict-derived-comparison.

proof.text: Apply ordinaryScalarEvaluationUnit to the coefficient ring systems and their scalar map. Its inverse-mate construction gives rho and the exact ordinary unit equation. The generic evaluation functor is definitionally coefficientSequenceEvaluation.

Apply scalarCochainEvaluation_of_unit with this rho and its ordinary unit equation. The generic system and finite evaluations specialize to the stated coefficient evaluations, giving the required universal cochain counit equation.

theorem coefficientScalarCochainEvaluation :
    letI := coefficientScalarModelZero A.scalar
    ∃ ρ : ∀ n : ℕ, A.scalar.model.E ⋙ coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L W n ≅
        coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n ⋙ (A.levels n).model.E,
      IsCoefficientScalarEvaluationUnit l E L ι W A ρ ∧
      ∀ (C : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E W) ℤ) (n : ℕ),
        letI := coefficientExtensionSystemEvaluationZero l E L ι W A n
        letI := coefficientExtensionEvaluationFiniteZero l E L ι W A n
        (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l L W n).map (A.scalar.model.ε.app C) ≫
            (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L W n).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
              ((A.scalar.model.E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C) ≫
            DerivedCategory.Q.map
              ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (ρ n) (.up ℤ)).hom.app C) =
          (A.evaluation n).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C) ≫
            (A.levels n).T.map
              ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app C) ≫
            (A.levels n).model.ε.app
              (((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C)
